propositions: Shutdown drain covers only the webhook queue via queue.join(), but reconcile_once awaits review_and_vote inline outside the queue, causing in-flight reconciler reviews to be cancelled within ~10s when the queue empties

Any container stop (manual docker compose, host reboot, systemd stop, autodeploy rollback) kills a reconciler review with effectively no drain, because the drain gap exists independent of the deploy-side autodeploy defer
The reconciler must stop accepting new reviews during shutdown drain so the in-flight count does not extend indefinitely while waiting for the current review to complete

Both webhook-queue and reconciler-review drains must share a single shutdown_drain_seconds() deadline to keep the overall grace period relationship valid (floor stays 1260s against 1320s stop_grace_period)
